<description>
**Problem:** An interrupted `loadtxoutset` can leave an incomplete `chainstate_snapshot` database without its required `base_blockhash` marker. A later call can fail to open that database, requiring the operator to remove it manually before retrying.

**Fix:** Wipe the snapshot database before opening it so a later call can replace incomplete data. LevelDB acquires the database lock before deleting files, so a database held open by another load cannot be wiped. Also correct the startup warning to identify the missing marker and explain that retrying replaces the directory.
</description>
